Land-ready maintainer proof for `e204cf11c5419c64592214c36175d67e946c5e5a` (rebased onto `a3804782dc9e`; Hermes patch unchanged):

- Latest-base Blacksmith Testbox `tbx_01kxegamm07dc3b2bnc54eh587` / Actions run https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/29279822157: `corepack pnpm test extensions/migrate-hermes src/plugin-sdk/migration-sensitive-redaction.test.ts` passed 90/90; `node scripts/run-tsgo.mjs -p tsconfig.core.json --incremental --tsBuildInfoFile .artifacts/tsgo-cache/core.tsbuildinfo` passed.
- Packaged behavior Testbox `tbx_01kxee3ba8yg6hm83pdspbdjwh`: `node scripts/package-openclaw-for-docker.mjs --output-dir .artifacts/hermes-import-e2e --output-name openclaw-hermes-import.tgz --allow-unreleased-changelog` passed build and tarball integrity. Isolated npm install then exercised list/dry-run/apply/reapply, stale plugin-index refresh, provider/auth/MCP/skills/memory/archive import, malformed YAML rejection, and a real local agent call to a mock OpenAI-compatible SSE endpoint. Markers: `HERMES_PACKAGED_E2E_OK`, `HERMES_IMPORT_OK`.
- `git diff --check` and generated Plugin SDK API baseline check passed. Two fresh autoreview cycles completed; all accepted findings fixed; no actionable findings remain.
- Full changed/prepare gates passed the Hermes-relevant format, SDK, package, storage, runtime-sidecar, focused-test, and core-type surfaces. Remaining hosted failures reproduce on current `main` outside this diff: UI startup request budget, dead-export cleanup format/lint fallout, transcript-policy fixtures, and raw-SQL architecture baseline. Repairs are tracked in #106751 and #106762. No failing path is under `extensions/migrate-hermes`, migration-provider runtime, or the changed Plugin SDK migration surface.

Known gap: current-main baseline prevents an all-green aggregate workflow. Scoped and packaged user-path proof is complete; this PR does not widen or suppress those checks.
